text:
Platinum Price in 1991
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1991, the LBMA platinum price fell 15.3% between 1991-01-31 ($392) and 1991-12-30 ($332). The highest sampled price was $404 in February and the lowest was $332 in December. The mean of these observations was $370. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
